parameters.content:
## NWI - BC Customers -> HubSpot companies (daily): set up before publishing
1. Connect credentials: **HubSpot Service Key account** and **Business Central – NWI Group (client credentials)**. Confirm no "not connected" warning on any node.
2. Settings -> Error Workflow: set the shared error handler (not set in this file). Settings -> Timezone: Australia/Sydney, so the schedule means Sydney time.
3. BC web service **Customer_Card** (page 21) must be published.
4. HubSpot company property `business_central_id` holds the BC number and is how a record is matched. Dropdown values must include every BC value or that batch of 100 fails.
5. **Workflow Config** holds the lookback window (24h = from the moment the workflow runs back to 24 hours earlier), batch size and the BC-field -> HubSpot-property map.
6. Runs at midnight. The contact sync runs an hour later, so new companies exist before their new contacts are created.

**What it does:** finds BC customers created or changed in the 24 hours before the run. Missing in HubSpot (matched on `business_central_id`) -> CREATED (blocked or nameless customers are skipped). Already in HubSpot -> UPDATED, only properties whose value differs. BC wins. A blank in BC never clears HubSpot. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: Every Day
nodes.notes: Runs once a day at 00:00 (set the workflow timezone to Australia/Sydney). Production runs only - publish the workflow.

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: lookbackHours: how far back from the run time to look (24 = the last 24 hours). matchProperty: HubSpot property holding the BC number. fieldMap: BC field -> HubSpot property.

nodes.name: List Changed BC Customers
nodes.notes: One call: every customer created or modified in the window.

nodes.name: Build BC Read Batches
nodes.notes: Splits the customer numbers into batches (batchSize each). One item per batch.

nodes.name: Read BC Customer Details
nodes.notes: One call per batch: all the fields we sync (and Blocked), for up to batchSize customers.

nodes.name: Find Matching Companies
nodes.notes: Read-only search (POST is only the HubSpot search convention): one call finds the HubSpot records for a whole batch, with their current values.

nodes.name: Build Company Writes
nodes.notes: Not in HubSpot -> create payload (blocked / nameless customers skipped). In HubSpot -> update payload with only the properties that differ.

nodes.name: Company Write Type
nodes.notes: Routes each item: create (new companies) or update (existing ones that changed).

nodes.name: Create Companies
nodes.notes: Batch create, up to 100 companies per call. Create call: no retry, by design.

nodes.name: Update Companies
nodes.notes: Batch update, up to 100 companies per call. Only differing properties are sent. Setting the same value twice is harmless.

parameters.content:
## 1. Find changed BC customers
One call lists everything created or modified in the lookback window.

## 2. Read details + find HubSpot records
Batches of 50: BC details in one call, matching HubSpot records in one search.

## 3. Create new + update changed
New customers are created, changed ones updated, 100 per call.
